use_when: to start an action, such as saving, continuing or submitting.
Use a Default button for the main action, once per section.
Use an Outline button for secondary actions, such as Cancel or Back.
Use a Semantic button when color should support the meaning, such as Positive to confirm or Negative to delete.

dont_use_when.when: to move to another page from inside a sentence.
as decoration or as a label.
Do not place two Default buttons side by side.
Do not mix Rounded and Pill shapes on one screen.
Do not write a long sentence as the label.

best_practice: Keep labels short and start with a verb, for example "Save changes".
Use icon-only buttons only for icons that are easy to recognize.
Use Disabled only when the action is temporarily unavailable.

variant_intent.type=Default: Figma: the main action, once per section.
variant_intent.type=Outline: Figma: secondary actions, such as Cancel or Back.
variant_intent.shape=Rounded: Renders the rounded shape. Figma: do not mix Rounded and Pill shapes on one screen.
variant_intent.shape=Pill: Renders the pill shape. Figma: do not mix Rounded and Pill shapes on one screen.
variant_intent.iconStyle=leading icon: Renders an icon before the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=trailing icon: Renders an icon after the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=Both icons: Renders an icon before and after the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=Icon only: Renders the icon alone; labelText becomes the accessible name. Figma: use icon-only buttons only for icons that are easy to recognize.
variant_intent.state=Default: Lets hover, press and focus happen naturally (code).
variant_intent.state=Hover: Pins the hover look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Press: Pins the pressed look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Focus: Pins the focus look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Disable: Disables the button. Figma: use Disabled only when the action is temporarily unavailable.

a11y.fact: Renders a native <button> element, so it takes keyboard focus and Enter/Space activate it.
A disabled button (state="Disable" or the disabled prop) is natively disabled.
An icon-only button gets aria-label from labelText unless aria-label is passed.
Shows a focus ring (2px page-colour gap, then 2px focus colour) on keyboard focus.
